conventions.router: React Router v6 style paths. `:param` segments are UUIDs.
conventions.auth: Routes with auth=true redirect unauthenticated users to /login?next=<attempted path>; after login/register the app navigates to `next` (default /).
conventions.mockup: mockupSection anchors into mockup.html (C1); apiCalls are operationIds from openapi.yaml (D2); the full trigger-level mapping is api-mapping.csv (D3).

routes.notes: Hero + 'New arrivals': first 4 products of listProducts?limit=4&sort=newest.
Reads optional ?next= query param. Links to /register.
Signs the user in on success (201 returns a JWT). Links to /login.
Filter sidebar (categories + sort) on Tablet/Desktop; hamburger drawer on Mobile. Grid 1/2/4 columns per breakpoint (NFR-005). Pagination component at bottom.
Quantity stepper capped at min(99, stockQuantity) (BR-003). Add to Cart requires login (guard applies on action, not on route entry).
Remove uses the confirm Modal. Empty state links to /products. Checkout button disabled when empty (BR-004).
Shipping address form (validation-rules.json `checkout`) + read-only summary with flat 5.00 shipping fee (BR-006). On 201 navigate to /orders/:orderId.
Doubles as the order-details view when opened from My Orders; the 'Thank you' banner shows only when arriving from checkout. Unknown/foreign id → 'Order not found.' state.
Newest first, 10 per page. Row click → /orders/:orderId. Empty state links to /products. Declare BEFORE /orders/:orderId in the router or use exact matching.

header.mobile: nav collapses behind the hamburger icon (menu.svg) at ≤375px

notFound.notes: Any unmatched path renders the shared empty-state layout with a link home. Not counted among the 9 screens.
